description: Work that already exists on the board under different wording, plus a bare status-check that is correctly not turned into a card.
note: The CROSS-BOUNDARY dispute hold (2a says new, 2b says existing) is covered by unit tests rather than a cassette: forcing two independent reads to disagree would mean fabricating a model reply, which defeats the point of recording. Here the first read caught the duplicate on its own, which is the healthy outcome.
